shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,260p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts scripts | head -80 && rg -n \"test-commands|descriptor.*spec|VALIDATED_BY|spec anchor\" scripts .lore src | head -120 && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,150p' && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Report nested tool input paths" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
